def _get_completions(cli, args, incomplete):
    comp = ShellComplete(cli, {}, cli.name, "_CLICK_COMPLETE")
    return comp.get_completions(args, incomplete)


def _get_words(cli, args, incomplete):
    return [c.value for c in _get_completions(cli, args, incomplete)]


def test_command():
    cli = Command("cli", params=[Option(["-t", "--test"])])
    assert _get_words(cli, [], "") == []
    assert _get_words(cli, [], "-") == ["-t", "--test", "--help"]
    assert _get_words(cli, [], "--") == ["--test", "--help"]
    assert _get_words(cli, [], "--t") == ["--test"]
    # -t has been seen, so --test isn't suggested
    assert _get_words(cli, ["-t", "a"], "-") == ["--help"]

    cli = Group("cli", params=[Option(["-a"])], commands=[Command("x"), Command("y")])
    assert _get_words(cli, [], "") == ["x", "y"]

    )

    assert _get_words(cli, ["-a", "a"], "-") == ["--help"]
    assert _get_words(cli, ["-a", "a", "x"], "-") == ["-a", "--help"]
    assert _get_words(cli, ["-a", "a", "x", "-a", "a"], "-") == ["--help"]


def test_chained():
    cli = Group(
        "cli",
        chain=True,
        commands=[
            Command("set", params=[Option(["-y"])]),
            Command("start"),
            Group("get", commands=[Command("full")]),
        ],
    )
    assert _get_words(cli, [], "") == ["get", "set", "start"]
    assert _get_words(cli, [], "s") == ["set", "start"]
    assert _get_words(cli, ["set", "start"], "") == ["get"]
    # subcommands and parent subcommands
    assert _get_words(cli, ["get"], "") == ["full", "set", "start"]

from collections import UserDict
from types import MappingProxyType

import pytest

import click
from click.shell_completion import ShellComplete


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mapping", [dict, UserDict, MappingProxyType])
def test_alias_returns_original_choice(mapping):
    canonical = "".join(["Original", "Choice"])
    target = canonical.encode().decode()
    assert target == canonical and target is not canonical
    choice = click.Choice([canonical, "Other"], aliases=mapping({"short": target}))

    assert choice.convert("short", None, None) is canonical
    assert choice.convert(target, None, None) is canonical


def test_alias_mapping_is_copied():
    aliases = {"short": "Alpha"}
    choice = click.Choice(["Alpha", "Beta"], aliases=aliases)
    aliases["short"] = "Beta"
    aliases["new"] = "Alpha"
    aliases.clear()

    assert choice.convert("short", None, None) == "Alpha"
    with pytest.raises(click.BadParameter):
        choice.convert("new", None, None)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "aliases", [False, 0, "", "short", [], [("short", "Alpha")], set()]
)
def test_aliases_must_be_a_mapping(aliases):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        click.Choice(["Alpha"], aliases=aliases)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "aliases",
    [
        {1: "Alpha"},
        {None: "Alpha"},
        {b"short": "Alpha"},
        {"short": 1},
        {"short": None},
        {"short": b"Alpha"},
        {"short": ["Alpha"]},
        {"short": "Missing"},
        {"short": "alpha"},
        {"short": "other", "other": "Alpha"},
    ],
)
def test_alias_names_and_targets_are_validated(aliases):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        click.Choice(["Alpha"], case_sensitive=False, aliases=aliases)


def test_alias_target_must_be_an_original_string_choice():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        click.Choice([1], aliases={"one": "1"})


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("case_sensitive", "normalize", "alias", "value"),
    [
        (True, None, "short", "short"),
        (False, None, "Straße", "STRASSE"),
        (True, str.strip, " short ", "short "),
        (
            False,
            lambda value: value.replace("Q", "prefix").replace("-", ""),
            "Q-ALIAS",
            "PREFIX-ALIAS",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_alias_normalization(case_sensitive, normalize, alias, value):
    canonical = " Q-Choice "
    choice = click.Choice(
        [canonical], case_sensitive=case_sensitive, aliases={alias: canonical}
    )
    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("cli"), token_normalize_func=normalize)

    assert choice.convert(value, None, ctx) is canonical
    assert choice.convert(canonical, None, ctx) is canonical


def test_alias_is_case_sensitive_by_default():
    choice = click.Choice(["Alpha"], aliases={"short": "Alpha"})

    with pytest.raises(click.BadParameter):
        choice.convert("SHORT", None, None)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", ["short", "Alpha", "unknown"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("choices", "aliases", "case_sensitive", "normalize"),
    [
        (["Alpha", "Beta"], {"short": "Alpha", "SHORT": "Beta"}, False, None),
        (["Alpha", "Beta"], {"Alpha": "Beta"}, True, None),
        (["Alpha", "Beta"], {"ALPHA": "Beta"}, False, None),
        (["Straße", "Beta"], {"STRASSE": "Beta"}, False, None),
        (["Alpha", "Beta"], {"short": "Alpha", " short ": "Beta"}, True, str.strip),
        (["Alpha", "Beta"], {" Alpha ": "Beta"}, True, str.strip),
        (["Alpha", "ALPHA"], {"alpha": "ALPHA"}, False, None),
        (
            ["Alpha", "Beta"],
            {"Q-ALIAS": "Alpha", "prefix-alias": "Beta"},
            False,
            lambda value: value.replace("Q", "prefix").replace("-", ""),
        ),
    ],
)
def test_conflicting_aliases_fail_during_conversion(
    choices, aliases, case_sensitive, normalize, value
):
    choice = click.Choice(choices, case_sensitive=case_sensitive, aliases=aliases)
    param = click.Option(["--choice"], type=choice)
    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("cli"), token_normalize_func=normalize)

    with pytest.raises(click.BadParameter, match="ambiguous") as exc_info:
        choice.convert(value, param, ctx)

    assert exc_info.value.param is param
    assert exc_info.value.ctx is ctx


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case_sensitive", [True, False])
def test_collisions_with_same_target_are_allowed(case_sensitive):
    choice = click.Choice(
        ["Alpha", "Beta"],
        case_sensitive=case_sensitive,
        aliases={
            "Alpha": "Alpha",
            " Alpha ": "Alpha",
            "short": "Alpha",
            " short ": "Alpha",
        },
    )
    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("cli"), token_normalize_func=str.strip)

    for value in ["Alpha", " Alpha ", "short", " short "]:
        assert choice.convert(value, None, ctx) is choice.choices[0]


def test_casefolded_collisions_with_same_target_are_allowed():
    choice = click.Choice(
        ["Straße"],
        case_sensitive=False,
        aliases={"STRASSE": "Straße", "strasse": "Straße"},
    )

    assert choice.convert("Strasse", None, None) is choice.choices[0]


def test_collisions_depend_on_conversion_context():
    choice = click.Choice(["Alpha", "Beta"], aliases={"ALPHA": "Beta"})
    ctx = click.Context(click.Command("cli"), token_normalize_func=str.casefold)

    assert choice.convert("ALPHA", None, None) == "Beta"
    with pytest.raises(click.BadParameter, match="ambiguous"):
        choice.convert("ALPHA", None, ctx)
    assert choice.convert("ALPHA", None, None) == "Beta"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("aliases", [None, {}, {"other": "Beta"}])
def test_canonical_collisions_keep_existing_behavior(aliases):
    choice = click.Choice(
        ["Alpha", "ALPHA", "Beta"], case_sensitive=False, aliases=aliases
    )

    assert choice.convert("alpha", None, None) is choice.choices[1]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parameter", [click.Option, click.Argument])
def test_alias_cli_and_canonical_displays(runner, parameter):
    choice = click.Choice(["Alpha", "Beta"], aliases={"shortcut": "Alpha"})
    is_option = parameter is click.Option
    param = parameter(["--choice" if is_option else "choice"], type=choice, required=True)
    cli = click.Command("cli", params=[param], callback=lambda choice: click.echo(choice))
    prefix = ["--choice"] if is_option else []

    result = runner.invoke(cli, prefix + ["shortcut"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output == "Alpha\n"

    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["--help"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert ("[Alpha|Beta]" if is_option else "{Alpha|Beta}") in result.output
    assert "shortcut" not in result.output

    result = runner.invoke(cli, prefix + ["unknown"])
    assert result.exit_code == 2
    assert "'unknown' is not one of 'Alpha', 'Beta'." in result.output
    assert "shortcut" not in result.output

    result = runner.invoke(cli)
    assert result.exit_code == 2
    assert "Choose from:\n\tAlpha,\n\tBeta" in result.output
    assert "shortcut" not in result.output

    complete = ShellComplete(cli, {}, "cli", "_CLI_COMPLETE")
    assert [item.value for item in complete.get_completions(prefix, "")] == [
        "Alpha",
        "Beta",
    ]
    assert complete.get_completions(prefix, "short") == []


def test_single_choice_invalid_message():
    choice = click.Choice(["Alpha"], aliases={"short": "Alpha"})

    with pytest.raises(click.BadParameter) as exc_info:
        choice.convert("unknown", None, None)

    assert exc_info.value.message == "'unknown' is not 'Alpha'."
